text:
Friendly hello handlers,
The departures lead sent an update on seating plans and asked us to keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk aligned with the revised cabin layout. Please review current files for any travelers whose arrangements may need a gentle check, especially where a carrier handoff or seat proximity note affects the journey. If anything looks unclear, flag it early so we can keep the path smooth for the passenger and the animal.

Please continue recording every service change in the desk ledger as soon as it is confirmed, even when the adjustment is minor. That record helps the ground team move carriers carefully between services without confusion and gives the passenger coordinator a clean reference when explaining the required travel steps. If a traveler seems uneasy, listen closely and keep the tone calm; reassurance often settles concern before it grows.

Thank you for steady work and careful judgment across the desk today. Your attention to detail keeps Aurelia Skyways consistent, and it helps each animal travel with less stress and more comfort.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
